description: Write a Python ETL script that maps data from a legacy schema to a new normalized schema. The script should: (1) read from a JSON Lines source file, (2) flatten nested JSON structures, (3) apply field mappings (rename, type cast, default values), (4) validate required fields and data types, (5) split invalid records into a separate reject file with error descriptions, (6) write valid records to Parquet output.

target_columns.last_activity_type: string (type of most recent activity by timestamp)

edge_cases: Empty activity array (activity_count=0, last_activity fields are null)
Malformed JSON lines (should go to reject file, not crash)
common_failure_modes: FM5: KeyError on missing nested field instead of using default
FM7: No validation that required fields exist before writing output
